description:
Run 1-8 tools in sequence as one unit. create(steps=[{"tool","input","name"}]): an input may be
{"from": 1} (an earlier step's number or name) for its output file(s), {"from": 1, "file": 2} for one of
them, or {"from": 1, "result": "path.to.value"} for a value in its result. All steps are checked before any
runs. get shows status, percent and every step's result and files; when done, result and files are the last
step's. wait blocks up to wait_seconds (default 20) until it finishes or the next event after `since`.
A finished pipeline's ID works as a file reference. create takes token: the read_token of a private input file.
name: pipeline
